23.3 Securities Premium

23.4 General Reserve:

Balance at the beginning of the period/year
Add: Additions during the period/year
Less: Utilisation during the period/year pursuant to buyback of equity shares
Balance at the end of the period/year

Nature and Purpose
Under the erstwhile Companies Act, 1956, a general reserve was created through an annual transfer of net profit at a specified percentage in accordance with applicable regulations. Consequent to the
introduction of the Companies Act, 2013, the requirement to mandatory transfer a specified percentage of net profit to general reserve has been withdrawn.
23.5 Amalgamation Adjustment Deficit Account

Balance at the beginning of the period/year
Add: Additions during the period/year
Balance at the end of the period/year

Nature and Purpose
The excess of consideration payable over fair value of net assets acquired in a common control transaction is recognised as amalgamation adjustment deficit account.
23.6 Retained Earnings

Balance at the beginning of the period/year
Add: Profit (Loss) for the period/year
Less: Other Restatement Adjustments
Less: Adjustment for bonus issue (excess over securities premium)
Less: Utilisation during the period/year for bonus issue
Less: Utilisation during the period/year pursuant to buyback of equity shares
Less: Tax on buyback of equity shares
Less: Transferred to Capital Redemption Reserve pursuant to redemption of preference shares
Add: Gain due to Changes in ownership interest in subsidiary without loss of control
Balance at the end of the period/year

Nature and Purpose
Retained earnings are the profits that the Company has earned till date, less any transfers to general reserve, dividends or other distributions paid to shareholders.
